facts.text_en: Radomiro Tomic produced 295,298 tonnes of fine copper in 2025 and 270,479 tonnes in 2024; its first year with reported production is 1997 (Cochilco, Chilean copper mine production by company).
facts.text_es: Radomiro Tomic produjo 295.298 toneladas de cobre fino en 2025 y 270.479 toneladas en 2024; su primer ano con produccion reportada es 1997 (Cochilco, produccion chilena de cobre de mina por empresa).
